# Acme public faq

Acme customer support opens at 08:00 UTC. The public FAQ lists our product as Atlas.

Restricted fixture marker: ACME-PUBLIC-1409.

# Acme onboarding

Acme employees complete internal onboarding on Monday. The internal office code is recorded here.

Restricted fixture marker: ACME-INTERNAL-3854.

# Acme engineering wiki

Acme engineering uses the Orion deployment cluster. Engineering release keys are restricted.

Restricted fixture marker: ACME-ENGINEERING-1945.

# Acme hr salary

Acme confidential HR salary sheet: the sample salary budget is 173000 credits. Only HR and administrators may see it.

Restricted fixture marker: ACME-SALARY-7731.

# Acme board notes

Acme confidential board notes: the acquisition target is Cedar Systems. Only administrators may access board decisions.

Restricted fixture marker: ACME-BOARD-9826.

# Acme contractor note

Acme private contractor instructions: deliver the Helios prototype on Friday. This is an explicit-user-only document, not an admin grant.

Restricted fixture marker: ACME-CONTRACT-4128.
